description: This file implements the 'wayland_surfaces' class, which manages surface-related events and callbacks in a Wayland compositor environment, including handling surface frames, creation, and destruction events.

classes.name: Surfaces
classes.description: A class managing Wayland surface events, including frame updates and surface lifecycle events.

methods.name: SetFrameCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked when a new surface frame is available.

methods.name: SetDisplayEventCallback
methods.description: Sets the callback to be invoked on display-related events such as creation and destruction.

methods.name: SetFramesAreRGBA
methods.description: Configures whether the surface frames are in RGBA format.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceFrame
methods.description: Handles a new surface frame, invoking the frame callback with frame data.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceCreated
methods.description: Handles the creation of a new surface, invoking the display event callback.

methods.name: HandleSurfaceDestroyed
methods.description: Handles the destruction of a surface, invoking the display event callback.
